title: What if you were the only man left on Earth?

beats.ray: Ray on his sunny street (trees, sun, his orange cat), smiling to camera
beats.gone: pull back: empty street, piles of empty shoes + hats where men stood
beats.big: a gold crown pops on Ray's head, confetti, smug pose; the cat yawns
beats.maya: Maya (long hair, red jacket) slides in, arms folded
beats.york: WHIP to a New York street: skyscrapers, fire station, a dalmatian
beats.lost: a wall of 50 helmets: 49 pop away, 1 is left
beats.two: label: under 2% of NYC firefighters are women
beats.america: WHIP to a US road at dusk, power poles, a streetlight sparking
beats.electricians: label: ~97% of US electricians are men
beats.toolbox: Maya grabs a toolbox, a hard hat pops on
beats.fast: she fixes it: streetlights pop on, moon and stars
beats.rwanda: WHIP to green hills under the sun: a parliament building
beats.future: WHIP down into a frosty freezer vault: FROZEN SAMPLES
beats.boys: WHIP to a nursery at night (moon, stars): baby boys in blue caps
beats.special: WHIP back to the street: Ray's crown slips off and clanks
beats.good: Maya grins, the cat sits on the crown; Maya walks off
beats.subscribe: SUBSCRIBE button + cursor; Ray looks up
